intro.title: Test User Interactions
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple interactive form component and learn how to test user interactions like typing and clicking. You'll use Vue's reactive data properties to manage form state and Vue Test Utils to simulate user actions in a test environment. The core concept is writing unit tests that verify your component responds correctly to user input, ensuring your UI behaves as expected. You'll work with Vue components, Jest or Vitest for testing, and event handling to create a reliable, test-driven user interface.
intro.usecase: Testing user interactions is essential for ensuring that interactive components in real applications behave correctly. In e-commerce sites, you need to verify that product filters update search results when users click category buttons or adjust price sliders. For SaaS dashboards, you must test that data visualizations respond properly when users toggle between different time periods or metric views. Form validation testing ensures that error messages appear appropriately when users submit incomplete information, while modal interactions confirm that overlays open and close as expected during user workflows.
